acceptance_criteria: The shared PDP renders a 'Why this formula' section immediately after the main purchase area and before the Build Your Routine bundle cards
Each product with a custom.why_this_formula metafield shows its own subheading and up to 4 unique heading/text cards
The card grid renders two columns on desktop and stacks to one column on mobile without horizontal overflow
A product with no custom.why_this_formula metafield and no section blocks renders no section (no broken empty state)
